neighbours.label: What someone should do differently or do more of ('needed to change my life', 'necessary to drink more', 'suggest you start', 'get off my'); the same actions reported as plain facts stay low.
fire: The doctor told me that I needed to change my diet.
You really need to drink more water in summer.
I would advise you to start walking every day.
She knows she should get off the couch more.
Most adults need to eat more fiber.
We could all learn a little from their example.
It is time to cut back and get more sleep.
He realized he had to quit smoking soon.
quiet: The doctor told me that I had a cold.
You really drank more water last summer.
I saw you walking in the park yesterday.
She sat on the couch all night.
Most adults ate more fiber at lunch.
We all heard a little about their trip.
It was time for bed and I went to sleep.
He smoked a pipe when he was young.

short: what someone should change or do more of
notes: Probes: 0.17-0.57, peak tokens vary. 'He drank more fluids yesterday' 0.19, others 0.01. The output direction promotes ' improve', ' better', ' less', and suppresses ' keep', ' maintain'.
